$comment: fp-bridge/2 (SEC-DESIGN.md 3.4, DESIGN.md 3.7): classic live upload host <-> fORM- dms-upload child over a MessagePort in a sandboxed iframe. `hello` and `port` travel on the window (via: window); everything else on the port. Every message is a closed object: an unknown key is invalid, so no message can carry a bearer. Only `collected` carries values, once per `req`; `state` never does. `init` carries is_secret, legacy, linkedTo, optionParents and fp_lookup per field, a `masked` list (a masked secret is null in `values`) and no hidden fields. Requests carry `id`, results echo it as `replyTo` (as in /1). Each case is {name, input, expect:{valid, why?}} plus `via` and `dir`. Field ids c2... are made up.

expect.why: no message has a field that could hold a bearer
hidden fields are never sent (dms-api drops them for the reader)
null means masked and must be listed
a masked id must be null in values
only declared lookups may be asked for
values are keyed by field id
Tax Id is untouched and therefore absent
ids only; the parent maps ids to names
